label: Mast cell-derived IL-13 as a driver of Crohn disease-associated intestinal fibrosis.
summary: Crohn disease is a chronic, immune-mediated disease that can lead to intestinal fibrosis, strictures, and bowel obstruction. The Src homology 2 domain-containing inositol polyphosphate 5'-phosphatase-deficient (SHIP-/-) mouse develops spontaneous Crohn disease-like ileal inflammation and fibrosis. Fibrosis depends on increased phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase p110δ activity downstream of interleukin 4 (IL-4) or IL-13.
